summary: Revised the implementation DAG in docs/compiler-agent/PROJECT_STATE.json per all five REQUEST_CHANGES findings of review-001 (contract_digest 6f5bb56b3faa9d3e2667a7531074dd15dc097ccc1546c4f7b343ba98ca3f31a4), amending only the affected task contracts (no task id re-created; 23 unique ids before and after). (1) Loop lowering now precedes its consumers: T009, T010 and T011 all declare T008 in dependencies (deps T007,T008). For T010 the dependency option was chosen over binding the IME slice to loop-free dot cases, so its full scope and acceptance (K-loop accumulator chaining, tails, IME operand constraints, counted smt.vmadot/smt.vfwmadot execution) are unchanged and it still precedes matrix breadth T014 per the architecture's validation route. (2) The 146 pat.persistent_reduce operators are now validated exactly once, in T009 (which owns both loop and reduction lowering and depends on T008); T008 acceptance[0] was re-scoped to validate loop mechanics over its non-reduction families (flow.while 15, flow.if 160, flow.tl_range 25, flow.static_range 21, if_pid 11) with loop-bearing non-reduction operators, and explicitly disclaims the persistent family ('validated exactly once, in T009 ..., not here'); T008 acceptance[1..3] and every other task's acceptance are byte-identical. (3) T014 now depends on T011 and consumes memory-forms-v1 (block pointers for flash_varlen/attention, pointer tables for grouped GEMM). (4) T008 declares its lowering output path a100c/lower/scalar.py (control flow to MIR branches per ARCHITECTURE_CONSTRAINTS.json) in outputs and belongs to the a100c-lowering-backend conflict group (with T007/T010/T011/T014), keeping its a100c-ir-frontend membership. (5) T006's elementwise-core scope now names the tensor-creation forms explicitly: tl.arange (466 operator files; start/end define the block index space), tl.zeros (147; shape, dtype), tl.full (56; shape, value, dtype) and tl.zeros_like. All six amendments went through the engine's task-amend command (Decisions D001-D006). One caveat, recorded transparently: task-amend cannot set conflict domains (Engine.AMENDABLE_FIELDS excludes 'conflicts' and neither the CLI nor the MCP amend tool has a --conflict flag), so T008's a100c-lowering-backend membership was applied as a one-field change through the engine's own state API under the workspace lock and recorded as Decision D007; no other field or task was touched by it. Verification: --json tasks shows the amended dependencies/consumes/conflicts/outputs with no duplicate ids; architecture-check --declaration-only still reports ok=true with zero errors and zero warnings (132 pending paths, unchanged count); the DAG is acyclic with no dangling references; a before/after field-level delta shows exactly the intended fields changed (T006 goal; T008 acceptance/outputs/conflicts; T009/T010/T011 dependencies; T014 dependencies/consumes) and nothing else; sha256 checks prove ARCHITECTURE_CONSTRAINTS.json (root and docs mirror), COMPILER_ARCHITECTURE.md (root and docs mirror) and chip.md are byte-identical. G3's only failing check remains 'latest review passed': the fresh independent plan review of this revised DAG is the manager's next step (advance_to PLAN_REVIEW); 'plan is structurally executable', 'task acceptance is verifiable' and 'architecture review matches the declared contract' (6f5bb56b3faa) all pass.
